evidence.behavior: Existing Recipe.ProductId is overwritten; requested active Product.RecipeId is set; old product backlink is not loaded/cleared.
Model comment describes Product.RecipeId as a plain nullable reporting pointer and Recipe.ProductId as relation.
Recipe ProductId FK and recipe item relation are configured; these spans show no reciprocal sync/uniqueness rule.
Food-cost report resolves each sold line using current Product.RecipeId then current recipe items/costs; stale old pointer can cost both products with one recipe if exclusivity intended.
Cited tests cover creation and same-product recipe-line replacement, not retargeting.

items.call_chain: settle route -> handler -> delivery facts/scope/rules -> open business day -> financial journal and incoming movement if actual positive -> custody/delivery settlement rows, event and audit -> save/commit
items.source_reasoning: Request replay first; rejects negative actual; requires delivery_manage and stricter settlement approval for variance. Transaction takes row locks over driver nonterminal deliveries and unsettled custody; rejects unresolved active deliveries. Settlement expected is sum of already-collected custody; positive actual creates incoming Main treasury movement with journal, zero actual creates no movement but still closes resolved delivery/custody rows. Settlement, events, audit, movement/journal and status changes save/commit together.
items.counterevidence: Same request replay is deduped; row locks cover distinct request IDs, and test source asserts one successful concurrent settlement/movement. Collected cash is explicitly the expected handover basis; original responsibility variance is recorded during delivery result. Whether UI wording should call that expected is owner policy, not proof of duplicate payment.
items.tests_and_limits: Tests cover correct cash-to-Main, variance reason/approval, same-key replay, concurrent distinct keys; no competing reassign/settle/provider lock test. Tests not run.
items.authorization_and_replay_boundary: Idempotency replay check is before actor lookup/authorization. Replays are no-write; outer authentication/authorization and request-id secrecy were not assessed, so do not claim an auth bypass.

items.call_chain: result route -> handler -> status transition/facts/rules -> delivery/custody update -> event/audit -> save/commit
items.source_reasoning: Only Delivered/Failed/Returned accepted; actor permission checked; delivery row locked in transaction. Delivered derives expected responsibility, defaults collected to expected, requires reason for variance, updates delivery and existing custody Collected/Difference. Failed/Returned require reason. Event/audit and state commit; no order payment change or treasury movement. Same-status new request is no-write, so it cannot correct a previous collected amount.
items.counterevidence: Row lock, transition guard and same-request replay protect a repeated event; inspected tests cover default collection, variance reason, failure reason and idempotent event. Outcome is custody evidence, not treasury cash receipt.
items.tests_and_limits: No test of changed amount with same-status new request, correction path, or concurrent settlement/result. Tests not run.
items.authorization_and_replay_boundary: Idempotency event replay occurs before actor lookup/authorization and returns current status without mutation. External route/host restrictions are outside this bounded review; no bypass claim.
